1. Architectural Overview & Design Philosophy

Retiam avoids monolithic, hard-coded WGSL shader strings. Instead, it features a **modular, composable shader system** with compile-time preprocessor macros, slot-based injections, schema-driven memory layouts, and automated WebGPU pipeline reflection.

blocks.text: 2. Procedural Shader Generation ([ShaderBuilder.ts](../src/engine/render/shadersystem/ShaderBuilder.ts))
The `ShaderBuilder` class allows components to assemble shader pipelines dynamically while maintaining strict types.
Slot Injection Mechanism
Instead of modifying shader files directly, components register code into predefined hook slots:

items: `header`: Global structs, helper functions, and WGSL includes.
`vertex_init`: Code executed at the beginning of the vertex shader.
`vertex_post`: Code executed after world transform evaluation.
`fragment_lighting`: Custom lighting or BRDF evaluation logic.

blocks.text: Preprocessor Directives (#if, #elif, #else, #endif)
`ShaderBuilder` processes conditional compilation directives on the CPU before handing code to the WebGPU shader compiler:
Variable interpolation `${variable}` allows dynamic values (like blur radiuses, loop counts, and array sizes) to be embedded directly into WGSL code.
3. The Shader Chunk Library ([ChunkRegistry.ts](../src/engine/render/shadersystem/ChunkRegistry.ts))
Retiam maintains a modular library of reusable shader snippets:

cells.text: Cook-Torrance microfacet BRDF with GGX normal distribution, Smith shadowing, and Schlick Fresnel.
Technical illustration shading using warm ($c_{\text{warm}}$) and cool ($c_{\text{cool}}$) tone transitions.
Multi-band stepped threshold lighting for stylized non-photorealistic rendering.
Soft studio clay shader with ambient occlusion and directional hemisphere lighting.
Percentage-Closer Filtering (PCF) cascaded shadow map sampling.
Exact distance functions (sphere, box, cylinder, torus) and operators (smooth union, subtraction).
Quaternion transformations, Rodrigues rotation formula, and Euler rotations.
Arc-length lookup, Chaikin subdivision smoothing, and dashing patterns.

blocks.text: 4. Schemas & Layout Generation
To eliminate manual calculations of vertex strides and uniform byte offsets, Retiam uses declarative schemas:
A. [VertexSchema.ts](../src/engine/render/shadersystem/schemas/VertexSchema.ts)
Defines vertex and instance attribute configurations:
B. [VaryingSchema.ts](../src/engine/render/shadersystem/schemas/VaryingSchema.ts)
Generates the bridge struct between vertex and fragment stages:
C. [UniformSchema.ts](../src/engine/render/shadersystem/schemas/UniformSchema.ts)
Calculates exact 16-byte alignment according to the WGSL specification, ensuring WebGPU memory safety without manual padding calculation errors.
5. Automated Pipeline Reflection ([WGSLReflector.ts](../src/engine/render/pipelines/WGSLReflector.ts))
Using `wgsl_reflect`, Retiam inspects the WGSL abstract syntax tree at runtime to automatically synthesize `GPUBindGroupLayoutEntry` arrays:

items: **Storage Buffers**: Detects read-only vs. read-write access modes (`type: 'read-only-storage'` vs `'storage'`).
**External Textures**: Automatically detects `texture_external` bindings for HTML5 `<video>` textures and configures WebGPU external texture layouts.
**Samplers**: Automatically determines filtering vs. comparison samplers.

blocks.text: 6. Pipeline Caching ([PipelineCache.ts](../src/engine/render/shadersystem/PipelineCache.ts))
Compiling `GPURenderPipeline` instances in WebGPU is asynchronous and computationally expensive. `PipelineCache` implements thread-safe memoization:

items: **Cache Key Formulation**: Hashes the generated WGSL string along with blend modes, depth-stencil formats, cull modes, and sample count:
Subsequent requests for matching pipeline configurations return cached instances in $O(1)$ time, eliminating frame drops during animated scene transitions.
